title: Navigation cost has a baseline before the split
goal: benchmarks.py has a paid navigation scenario with three prompts, each asking a Sonnet agent in a throwaway clone which functions and tests to change: a query-log delivery rule, a kbgit.py trailer or sync rule, and a benchmark scenario; answers are checked by function and test names that survive a file move, and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds three runs of it at a pre-split commit (arm before) with files read, tool calls, turns and input tokens
notes: Three runs per arm on Sonnet. Checks name functions and tests, never file paths, so the same scenario scores the split layout. Each prompt matches a file the sprint splits: test_querylog.py, kbgit.py and its tests, benchmarks.py.
